schema.name: validate_table
schema.description: Validate EVERY original CSV/TSV record to EOF before filtering or deduplication. For explicitly supplied table inputs this is required before completion, even if Python already calculated outputs. Provide fields for ALL columns using the task's rules: text/integer/decimal/date(YYYY-MM-DD)/boolean(true,false)/enum. Required by default; use nullable=true only when allowed. Decimal is finite and supports minimum/maximum as strings and scale. Enum requires explicit values. Schema is locked after a scan, including failures. Transaction tables (amount/status/revision plus id/order_id/refund_id) enforce required IDs, revision integer minimum>=1, amount decimal minimum>=0 scale<=2, status/region/currency enums, date as date and is_test as boolean when present; these checks cannot be weakened to text or nullable. Other tables use the declared rules. Inputs must stay unchanged. Returns hashes, full row and field counts, and at most 20 error samples. Declare purpose='diagnosis' BEFORE the first scan only when the task is to inspect/report data errors; otherwise use 'computation' (initial default). Purpose is locked for the run; omitted later calls inherit it. success/validation_complete mean the scan finished; data_valid reports data quality separately. A complete diagnosis may finish with data_valid=false; computation still requires valid input. Both require every input/field, EOF and unchanged hashes. Report all required findings and deliver/read back requested diagnostic artifacts. This validates source data, not the correctness of output calculations.

purpose.description: Task purpose, fixed before the first scan. Omit to inherit; initially computation. Diagnosis only inspects/reports data errors, not calculations requiring valid input.
